messages:
maria: AM standup — what I did: drafted 3 launch tweets + benchmark post outline. Blockers: waiting on final hero image from @rachel and variant copy approval from @amos. Today: finalize content calendar, upload hero to CMS, schedule tweet for 11:00 PT, coordinate CDN canary with eng.
amos: On infra/eng: pushed a small tweak to the image pipeline last night. Seeing a 502 on staging when images >2MB, so we should avoid huge files for the canary. Investigating root cause now. If @rachel can export at ~900KB that should be safe. I'll ping infra for the CDN canary at 10:30 PT.
rachel: Uploading new hero now. Compressing to ~900kb and adding alt text. ETA ~20m.
jake: Quick Q on the benchmark post — do we want to call out the median latency drop? @amos, can you export the small latency chart PNG to /shared/benchmarks? Also, is it accurate to say "~40% lower median latency with caching"?
amos: Yep — on yesterday's harness the median went from 210ms -> 130ms with prefix/KV caching enabled. "~40% lower median latency" is fair. I'll export the chart and drop it in /shared/benchmarks. Also leaving a quick health check to run before canary: `curl -I https://staging.cdn.redwood-inference.com/hero.jpg` (expect 200).
content-bot: Chart uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/storage/bench-2034.png :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks — @rachel once you finish uploading I'll slot the hero into the CMS and set UTM params. @jake can you update the post copy to include the chart and the ~40% stat? Anyone see any launch risk right now?
amos: No major launch risks from infra. I'll watch the canary at 11:00 and can rollback if errors spike. Quick k8s check if you need it: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=cdn` — healthy looks like 3/3 READY.
rachel: Done — hero uploaded here: https://redwood.cloud/assets/hero-900kb.jpg. I also added three alt text variants and a smaller 600px crop for mobile.
jake: :thumbsup: Updating copy now and adding the benchmark chart. Maria — can you add UTM params? I'll queue the post for 11:00 PT and tag analytics.
maria: Added UTM: ?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=bench-launch. Scheduling now for 11:00 PT. Thanks everyone — will ping if anything changes
